records.name: Kapitän Druckfest
records.biography_en: He regards pressure as something that should have been settled before departure. His copper helmet frames a face that has survived more pressure than the expedition's paperwork admits. HyperNorm sorts conditions into safe or somebody's responsibility. A dissonant card has made him check a neighbour's expression before checking the instrument. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Druck ist bekannt. Seine Verteilung bleibt unerfreulich.

variant_notes.note_en: He regards pressure as something that should have been settled before departure.

records.name: Bert Bergungsgut
records.biography_en: He calls every wreck a storage problem with an optimistic balance sheet. He carries a salvage key because every wreck looks more promising when described as storage. The building classifies objects as useful or abandoned. An ambiguous card has made him return a small keepsake that had no official value. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Bergung lohnt sich. Die Geschichte war im Inventar nicht enthalten.

variant_notes.note_en: He calls every wreck a storage problem with an optimistic balance sheet.

records.name: Nora Nachtprobe
records.biography_en: She collects evidence and is worried that it might be looking back. The sealed jar contains a luminous clay specimen and a question she has not yet found a category for. HyperNorm recognises evidence as confirming or contaminated. A contradictory card has taught her to keep the surprising observation rather than discard it. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Probe leuchtet. Eine Stellungnahme ihrerseits liegt nicht vor.

variant_notes.note_en: She collects evidence and is worried that it might be looking back.

records.name: Otto OhneEcho
records.biography_en: He pilots the remote vehicle with the confidence of someone waiting for the echo. His joystick box controls a vehicle that answers with the sort of delay the building calls reassuring. Residents are either responsive or defective. A dissonant card has made him wait patiently for a neighbour who needs more time to reply. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Signal ist unterwegs. Die Zuversicht wurde nicht mitgesendet.

variant_notes.note_en: He pilots the remote vehicle with the confidence of someone waiting for the echo.

records.name: Franz Flutlicht
records.biography_en: He wants a clear picture of something that has spent centuries avoiding publicity. His porthole camera records things the courtyard committee would prefer to imagine more clearly. HyperNorm files images as visible or irrelevant. An ambiguous card has made him keep an imperfect photograph because it mattered to the person in it. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Aufnahme ist scharf. Das Motiv hat weiterhin keine Öffentlichkeit bestellt.

variant_notes.note_en: He wants a clear picture of something that has spent centuries avoiding publicity.

records.name: Dora Dekompression
records.biography_en: She waits professionally for conditions to become ordinary again. Her pressure gauge and tea cup represent two very different ways to wait for normal conditions. HyperNorm calls patience professional until someone asks how long. A dissonant card has made her offer company instead of another estimate. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Dekompression läuft. Der Tee hat bereits Normaldruck.

variant_notes.note_en: She waits professionally for conditions to become ordinary again.
